args.body: Hi Jonah, thanks for your message and sorry for the wait. Boiler job R-4799: our engineer visited on 30 Sept and found a part (the expansion vessel) needs replacing. We sent the quote to your landlord, who has asked for a second quote before deciding. A second company, Swift P&H, is due to visit on 14 October to look at it. Once we have that quote, we'll go back to the landlord for a decision and let you know the next step. We can't give a repair date until that's approved. Until then, please keep topping up the pressure as you have been. If the heating or hot water stops completely, or you smell gas, tell us straight away (for gas call 0800 111 999). On bins: we don't manage collections, so I can't give you a date. Tower Hamlets Council runs them, and their website lets you check your collection day and report a missed collection. If you'd like us to log anything about bins at the property, let us know.
